title: Faded Passport
pitch: A border-crossing game in which your passport photo dissolves, through a quantum TeleBlur, into the home you can't return to.
technical: A mobile-first React + Vite web app with Vercel serverless functions as a proxy to the Moth Atlas API, so the API key never reaches the browser. The player's portrait, a photo of home and a hand-drawn face mask are cropped to 512×512 and sent to the telablur-v1 engine, which encodes both images in one quantum state and rotates a selector qubit between them. Years away set strength; the drawn outline sets the mask; the measured change inside the mask picks the officer's refusal.

genAI.notes: Code written with Claude Code; all images come from the player's own photos.
